items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XII, List of Answers on Terminology 127:1
items.html:
(to the question) Internality of the Katnut of Aba
The VAK of the five Hassadim, which ZA receives from the age of two years until the sixth year and one day, are called the inner ones of the Katnut of Aba. See item 119. (Part 1, Page 186, Item 179).
